notes.title: New Version Update 0.6.2.2
notes.content:
New Version Update 0.6.2.2

Hello everyone,

Please check out the patch notes below.

For Co-Op, I’ll need a couple more weeks to rework the gunfight and melee combat systems. These new combat mechanics will be implemented in the Co-Op version. You can check the current progress below.

I’ve built the Co-Op version from scratch with a focus on optimized memory usage and better performance. Many core systems and logic have been reworked to ensure it runs more smoothly than the single-player version. --Once the content in Co-Op reaches parity with the single-player version, The Co-Op build will be default version of the game (which will still support single-player mode) ** However, some gameplay mechanics like the new gunfight, recoil rework, and melee combat will remain exclusive to Co-Op and won’t be added to current build single-player (controller support as well).

*** To clarify, single-player remains the main focus for story content, quests, world-building, and overall game progression. All new areas, characters, and missions will continue to be developed primarily for the single-player experience. Only a few systems—like gunfight, melee, and controller support—are being developed specifically for Co-Op.

Also, the Co-Op version isn’t just for CooOp Mode —it supports single-player as well. So once it’s ready to replace the old build, you will still be able to choose whether you want to play solo or Co-Op, with all the new improvements included.

[list]
[*] Fixed: Incorrect popup message when trying to light a campfire with an empty lighter.
[*] Fixed: Tactical Grip spawning inside object stashes or skeletal meshes, making it unusable (couldn’t attach or display item icon).

[*] Fixed: Missing end animation when drinking.
[*] Fixed: Rick Camp Quest not granting rewards after camp rebuild.

[*] Fixed: Bandit Sniper’s laser not disappearing after being killed.
[*] Fixed: NPC Rescue Quest: When an allied NPC was sitting in a vehicle and the player drove them to camp, they would become bugged upon exiting—unable to interact and stuck in a rotation glitch.
[*] Fixed: Seeker Nest dissolving effect bug.
[*] Fixed: Removed Molotov debugging radius.
[*] Fixed: Stamina sometimes not regenerating after being fully depleted.
[*] Fixed: Killing a Cannibal with a firearm or flamethrower caused an excessive number of machetes to drop.
[*] Fixed: Crash when quitting to the main menu and then trying to load a save game
[*] Optimization: Slightly reduced memory usage (~100MB).
[/list]

[b][h3]Features[/h3][/b]

[*] Map Marker System: You can now place markers on the map by right-clicking and selecting a marker type. To remove a marker, simply click on it.

notes.title: New Version Update 0.6.2
notes.content:

This patch I focuses on performance fixes and introduces new core systems that will allow me to expand more content in the future. These core systems include NPC Dialogue, NPC Allies (overhaul), Collectable System, Bandit Armor System, Quest Board, and individual NPC Quests.

You can now access Zone 1 by defeating "TANK". Upon defeat, TANK will retreat, breaking through obstacles that block the way. At this point, you'll find a new NPC who will offer a quest with rewards in new weapons.

Please note that Zone 1 is still under development. It currently includes only structural elements and no loot or enemies, except for a Seeker at the end of the tunnel.

I have read all the reports from Discord and the forums regarding bug issues, and many will be addressed in the next patch, especially the disappearing dog and generator fuel issues.

Hello everyone, version 0.6.0 is now live!

[previewyoutube=x7S6hb-aXHw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]** Since I've upgraded the game from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5, I recommend uninstalling the old version and reinstalling the new one for the best experience. **[/b]

For those who wish to continue playing the previous version, 0.5.2.1, it remains accessible in the "old_build_052" branch, just like version 0.4.1.

To access these versions, go to Steam, right-click on "Mist," select "Properties," and then choose the desired branch.

Version 0.6.0 introduces numerous reworks and overhauls, which are detailed below:
[list]
[*] Project migration to Unreal Engine 5.
[*] Maps from version 0.4 have been completely reworked from the ground up while retaining the original landmarks and locations.
[*] New moving object system.
[*] Implementation of a new carry system.

notes.title: Premature Evaluation: Mist Survival
notes.content:
Premature Evaluation is the weekly column in which Steve Hogarty explores the wilds of early access. This week, he’s desperately trying to avoid soiling himself in Mist Survival.

Developer: Dimension 32 Entertainment
Publisher: Dimension 32 Entertainment

Release: Out now (early access)
On: Windows
From: Steam
For: 8.29

Of all the different forms of precipitation, mist is by far the spookiest. Mist is the last thing you want to see wafting out of a sepulchre, or coiling ominously around an abandoned log cabin on a moonlit night. Fog very much the Paul Chuckle to mist s Barry will do in a tight spot, but to really get your intestines pumping with fear enzymes, it s just got to be a creeping layer of good old-fashioned mist entwining itself around your bare ankles like the ice-cold fingers of your restless ancestors. (For the record, the least frightening form of precipitation is hailstones, which if they were to come flying at you from out of a crypt would be more confusing than scary.)

notes.title: Mist Survival - Development Roadmap
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to the latest updated roadmap for the game. I am hoping this will give you all an idea of where development is being focused and my plans through to the end of 2018:

[h1]#Game version : 0.1.x[/h1]
This version is all about bug fixing and getting the various gameplay mechanics balanced. I won’t be adding any new content for this version as I want to ensure the game as it stands provides a solid foundation as I move forward. Of course this does not mean everything will be set in stone during this version but it is the primary focus.

[h1]#Game version : 0.2.x[/h1]
This version is where new gameplay mechanics and new content will be added. To give you an example of upcoming content this version of the game will introduce the mining mechanic as well as two new breeds of infected, the ‘Berserker’ and the ‘Tank’.
In short I’ll be bringing in the following additional content throughout this phase of development:
[list]
     [*]New map location : To include a mine
     [*]New gameplay mechanic : Fully functional mining system
     [*]Additional craftable items: New tools, survival equipment and craftable building parts
     [*]A new weapon type: The hunting rifle
     [*]New infected:  The ‘Berserker’ and the ‘Tank’.
[/list]

[h1]#Game version : 0.3.x[/h1]
This version will focus heavily on advancing the survival systems and adding gameplay variety with the addition of new fauna types, along with the addition of a farming element:
[list]
     [*]New wildlife: Deer and wolves
     [*]New gameplay mechanic: Fully functional fishing system
     [*]New gameplay mechanic: Fully functional crop system
     [*]New gameplay mechanic: Fully functional traps. To include fish and bear traps.
[/list]

notes.title: Mist Survival Early Access Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Hello guys, 

I'm excited to annouce that Mist Survival will be released on Steam Early Access "August 15th". 

Check out the new trailer here. :)

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PcUi-whCWs8&feature=youtu.be

[h1]ABOUT MIST SURVIVAL[/h1]
Players will be immune from the virus outbreak and must survive the situation by hoarding food, finding shelter and protecting yourself from wildlife, bandits, and infected. Players can also help other survivors and get the survivors to join your camp.

Players will experience dense mist that can happen at any time. The dense mist environment is accompanied by certain events, such as the infected people come around to find preys.

People who are infected and mutated will be able to come out outdoors at night or when there is no sunshine that means they can also hunt players while the fog is covered.
